about: One table of track names for both ends (full audit 2026-10-02, reader S4.R10). `reserved` = no stem may carry it: server/mix_engine/session.py reserved_stem_name and daw/Source/DawSession.h isReservedTrackName must agree on every row. Read by server/tests/test_stem_name_parity.py and by the console leg MixAgentDAW --stem-names. A name another stem, group or return already uses is a different rule (taken, not reserved) and is not in this table.
